reconnect_path.evidence: A refused request is never appended (ratelimit.py:137-146), so the 120 in-window entries stay until the oldest ages out, Retry-After = int(oldest + window - now) + 1 (60 at most, 61 only on an exact monotonic tie), so a retry before that instant is refused again and only one slot frees per expiry, which means N requests opened together at the limit get one admitted per expiry; the MCP client's own retry code is not in this repository, so its retry timing is unknown.
